adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` defines computed keys as `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. `z.string()` returns a Zod object, so `.toString()` becomes `"[object Object]"` (and the second key likely collides/overwrites). This makes the schema expect a literal property named `"[object Object]"` rather than accepting arbitrary numeric expiry fields, so `safeParse(response)` will fail for normal OAuth token refresh responses when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is true, causing the refresh path to throw.
